This product makes everything easier and comfortable; cooking with one or both hands, feeding, taking long walks, aiding my oldest, etc.

The piece that goes around your waist is thick and supportive and there’s the safety buckle as well. This carrier doesn’t budge on my waist even with my son on my hip. The piece he sits on is so heavy duty and sturdy, I know he is safe sitting on it. I bought the hands free one because we have a few hands free carriers we received from our shower but I love how this one allows him to sit forward or inward easily if he’s fussy.
